what: REFUTED EXEMPLAR for III.4 (the composition test, entered as the 18th amendment): live_priors/scripts/eot-digest.mjs::loadOrgans built the-fold's hypergraph.js::makeRelationReader passing eleven of the twenty-five organs that function accepts, silently. resolvePronouns (eoreader7 kernel activation) was never imported at all, let alone passed. No article as it stood (I, II, III.1-III.3) was violated by any single member: eoreader7 offered the organ, the-fold accepted it as an optional parameter, live_priors simply never passed it. The composition degraded across all 2,208 stored corpus readings with nothing anywhere recording the omission.

measured_fix.recipe_change: live_priors/scripts/eot-digest.mjs — added import of eoreader7/native/adapters/text/pronouns.js; wired resolvePronouns + thirdPersonSingular into the makeRelationReader call; added UNION_OMITTED naming the fourteen organs left unwired, each with a real reason
measured_fix.activation_alone_isolated: at an 8000-char window across a 10-file sample (Aristotle/Dante/Byzantine Empire/Christianity/Buddhism/Cold War/Confucianism/Drama/Hamlet/UK 2008 c.27), resolvePronouns alone moved edge count by 0/319 — the measured jump above is dominated by this recipe's own pre-existing POS-prior path plus the wiring itself running for the first time, not by activation's raw yield. Activation's disclosed value is the regime block (framesWithPronouns/framesCoPresent/framesAdjudicated) it produces, not additional edges — that block is not yet captured by any sidecar, named as follow-up.
measured_fix.found_while_fixing: claims/blank-furniture-sentence-drift.claim.json — a real, separate bug in the-fold's blankLabelRows, surfaced only because this was the first time organs.blankFurniture was ever actually wired to makeRelationReader
